convert_number_to_words: convert the EnglishNumberNormalizer.convert method to spell out a number string like '42' into 'forty two'
spell_integer_number: spell out an integer number using the EnglishNumberNormalizer.spell_number method into English words
normalize_text_numbers: normalize all numbers in a text string using the EnglishNumberNormalizer.__call__ method to convert digits to spelled-out words
convert_currency_amount: convert a currency amount string like '$12.50' to spelled-out form like 'twelve dollars and fifty cents'
convert_negative_percent: convert a negative percentage string like '-3.14%' to spelled-out form like 'minus three point one four percent'
